card.name: Dampening effects and osmotic terms
card.fires_on: Fires on the end of verbs meaning to dampen or counter an effect (attenuate, ameliorate, counteract), and on pieces of the word osmotic in sodium or glucose passages.

modes.label: Dampening verbs
modes.description: The ending of verbs such as attenuate or ameliorate describing a drug blunting a physiological response.
modes.example: ol hydrochloride can attenu<<ate>> reflex tachycardia and increase

modes.label: Osmotic terms
modes.description: Pieces of the word osmotic or the linking word just before it, in text on osmolality, diuresis or demyelination.
modes.example: Hyperglycemia is associated with an increase in serum osmolality, resulting in osm<<otic>> diuresis, dehydration and electrolyte
